Hi Down To Earth Editorial Team,

I've been an avid reader of CSE's work on groundwater resilience and decentralized ecology for years.

pitch_subject: Bioclimatic architecture & chemical-free biological pool concept for The Bush Camp Chiang Mai
pitch_body:
Dear Founder,

I came across The Bush Camp Chiang Mai in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

As an architect specializing in ecological masterplanning and regenerative hospitality retreats, I noticed your property has exceptional terrain and microclimatic potential.

Tailored Architectural Concept: A chlorine-free natural swimming pool filtered organically through gravel-root reed beds, paired with passive solar chalets utilizing thermal mass to maintain 21°C–23°C indoor comfort without noisy HVAC compressors.

We engineer retreats to achieve net-zero operating energy while elevating the guest luxury experience.

I would be delighted to share a few site sketches and contour concepts if you have 10 minutes next week.

Warm regards,
Ar. Archana Gavas
Founder & Principal Architect, Anvitam
https://www.anvitam.com | Vadodara, India & Global Consultations
